scenes.title: Le double tournage  (The Double Shoot)
scenes.summary: At ASK, Hicham confronts Gabriel upon discovering that superstar Isabelle Huppert is illegally filming two productions at the same time.

scenes.title: Dans la loge d'Isabelle  (In Isabelle's Dressing Room)
scenes.summary: In her dressing room, Isabelle Huppert rehearses Shakespeare and explains her boundless artistic stamina to Gabriel between exhausting shoots.

scenes.title: L'avertissement de Charles  (Charles's Warning)
scenes.summary: At the courthouse, attorney Charles discreetly warns his longtime friend Mathias that Andréa Martel is plotting a secret departure from ASK.

scenes.title: Les écoles de théâtre  (Theater Schools)
scenes.summary: At ASK, Camille and Hervé debate splitting theater school showcases, joking about representation and Parisian snobbery.

scenes.title: Affaire de famille  (A Family Matter)
scenes.summary: Mathias confronts Camille about agency loyalty and family trust, leading Camille to consult Hervé about her father's suspicions.

scenes.title: Appel à la maternité  (Call at the Maternity Ward)
scenes.summary: At the maternity clinic, new mother Andréa takes an urgent business call from star client Fabrice Luchini while Colette and the nurse look on in disbelief.

scenes.title: L'invitation de Catherine  (Catherine's Invitation)
scenes.summary: Catherine visits Noémie at the agency to check on her neck brace, inviting her to dinner with her handsome physiotherapist while Mathias looks on.

scenes.title: La scène d'agonie  (The Agony Scene)
scenes.summary: On a period movie set, Isabelle Huppert delivers a dramatic and poignant death scene until the director calls cut.

scenes.title: Pas une machine  (Not a Machine)
scenes.summary: When an assistant demands another tight take, Isabelle Huppert refuses, arguing that after seven death scenes she cannot die on command like a machine.

scenes.title: Détour pour la radio  (Detour for the Radio)
scenes.summary: Mathias drives Isabelle Huppert to her night shoot, playing private chauffeur. When Laure Adler calls for a live radio interview that Isabelle completely forgot, Mathias panics, but Isabelle insists on making a twenty-minute detour.

scenes.title: Après le direct  (After the Live Show)
scenes.summary: Rushing out of the Radio France studio after her live interview with Laure Adler, Isabelle checks with Mathias on how her performance went. Mathias hurries her through the corridors to get back to the car before the American film set notices their absence.

scenes.title: Les répliques coupées  (Cut Lines)
scenes.summary: Arriving on the American film set, Isabelle Huppert discovers that director Gary has heavily trimmed her scene to make it more dynamic. Refusing to be treated as an extra, Isabelle furiously rejects Mathias's attempts to pacify her and demands an immediate confrontation with Gary.

scenes.title: Le showcase du conservatoire  (The Conservatory Showcase)
scenes.summary: At a drama school showcase, Camille scouts promising new actors, gives her card to a student, and shares a playful encounter with young actor Valentin.

scenes.title: Panique sur le plateau américain  (Panic on the American Set)
scenes.summary: On the American film set, star Ben Stiller refuses to leave his trailer after his lines are cut, throwing Mathias and Isabelle into a panic against the clock.

scenes.title: Tournage interrompu  (Shoot Suspended)
scenes.summary: On the French film set, Isabelle reappears with an alibi after Gabriel stalls the director, revealing how she cleverly shut down the rival shoot.

scenes.title: Restons solidaires  (Let's Stick Together)
scenes.summary: After an exhausting night shoot, Isabelle Huppert thanks Mathias and Gabriel before heading to a fashion show. Mathias reveals he knows about their plan to launch a secret agency and proposes that they unite to oust Hicham instead.

scenes.title: Des croissants chauds  (Warm Croissants)
scenes.summary: Mathias calls Noémie from outside her apartment building after the successful shoot. He thanks her warmly for saving the day, confirms she is alone, and brings warm croissants up to her flat.

scenes.title: Chez Noémie  (At Noémie's Apartment)
scenes.summary: Inside Noémie's apartment, Noémie prepares coffee while Mathias confesses that he cannot manage without her, asking her to forgive him and return to the agency.

scenes.title: Le mal de dos  (The Back Pain)
scenes.summary: Inside Noémie's apartment, Mathias winces from severe back pain caused by stressful nights at the office. Noémie shows genuine sympathy and serves him breakfast while Mathias reveals how vulnerable he feels without her.

scenes.title: La déclaration de naissance  (The Birth Declaration)
scenes.summary: At the maternity clinic, Hicham brings a teddy bear for the newborn baby. When the civil registrar arrives to complete the birth certificate, Andréa declares the child fatherless, sparking an intense clash with Hicham.

scenes.title: Une semaine d'interruption  (A Week of Shutdown)
scenes.summary: Gabriel receives a distressing call from Isabelle Huppert, who has completely lost her voice. With the American shoot shut down for a week, Andréa warns Gabriel that insurance investigators will uncover their illegal double shoot.

scenes.title: Le talent de Samy  (Samy's Talent)
scenes.summary: Camille and Hervé watch Samy's homemade audition tape at ASK. Hervé thinks he is terrible, but Camille sees raw potential and insists on representing him.

scenes.title: Le secret d'Isabelle Huppert  (Isabelle Huppert's Secret)
scenes.summary: Gabriel visits Isabelle Huppert at her apartment to make sure she is resting after halting production, only to discover she is secretly shooting an experimental film.

scenes.title: La percée du Yi-king  (The I Ching's Breakthrough)
scenes.summary: In his office, Noémie reads an inspiring passage from the I Ching to Mathias, revealing that the hexagram of the Breakthrough calls for decisive action, urging him to seize the moment and break through.

scenes.title: L'envoi du coursier  (Dispatching the Courier)
scenes.summary: Late at night at ASK, Mathias and Noémie prepare the confidential envelope containing the takeover documents. Mathias calls a dispatch service to send the documents across Paris, setting their plan into motion.
